name: Today FM
instructions: Complete the Stepping Stone online form with an audio file that meets their stated requirements; one entry per act, closing 13 November 2026. Winners get airplay support, an interview slot and an industry day in Dublin.
notes: Competition 'to identify and support emerging music talent in Ireland', shared across Today FM, 98FM, SPIN 1038, SPIN South West, iRadio, Beat and Red FM. Aimed at Irish acts, so a UK band is unlikely to be eligible. No general music submission route found on Today FM's site.

name: Flirt FM 101.3
instructions: Email download links (MP3 preferred, or WAV) with clear 'Artist - Song' file names; Spotify/YouTube fine for a first listen but they need an audio file. No AI-generated music or artwork; don't post physical copies from outside the EU.
notes: The page says 'We accept Irish music submissions', so the focus is Irish acts; a UK band may get less traction. Address is Cloudflare-obfuscated on the page (decoded).

name: 8Radio.com
instructions: No submission guidance on the site; the about page lists a general contact email, socials (@8RadioIreland) and a phone/WhatsApp line.
notes: Irish independent online indie/alternative station run by ex-Phantom 105.2 staff; plays new Irish and international alternative music and runs a weekly #8Recommends slot. Only a general contact address is listed.

name: CKUT 90.3 FM
instructions: Physical releases (CD, vinyl, cassette) by post preferred; digital 320 kbps MP3 submissions can go to music@ckut.ca. No singles: releases need at least three distinct tracks (7-inch vinyl excepted).
notes: Singles not accepted. FloodLines would need an EP of 3+ tracks.

name: CJSW 90.9 FM
instructions: Digital only, via the upload link on the submissions page: new albums (released within 3 months) with 3+ unique tracks, MP3 in a .zip. No singles.
notes: music@cjsw.com is listed only for artists who need help submitting digitally. Also runs a Campus Mailout service that forwards releases to other stations.

name: CIUT 89.5 FM
instructions: 'Contact newmusic@ciut.fm to submit music.' The station also uses the !earshot Distribution System and will give a referral code on request.
notes: music@ciut.fm is for bands performing locally in Toronto.

name: CJSR 88.5 FM
instructions: Email a digital album or EP to music@cjsr.com as download links (Bandcamp codes, Dropbox, Google Drive; no WeTransfer or streaming links), or post physical copies marked 'commercial sample'. Albums/EPs only, with track info and a short one-sheet.
notes: 'We don't accept single tracks. Albums or EPs only.'

name: CJLO 1690 AM
instructions: Accepts submissions from anyone in any genre via the form on the page. Releases are shared to 70+ Canadian campus/community stations through the NCRA's !earshot Distro (National Music Director Partnership).
notes: One submission reaches the wider Canadian campus-community network. The page has a section on accepting singles.

name: CFUV 101.9 FM
instructions: Send a download link (320 kbps MP3) to music@cfuv.ca with a one-page bio and track listing. Submissions need at least three unique tracks; singles can be bundled into a 'radio-only EP'.
notes: No physical copies unless you're local. Music Director: Troy Lemberg.

name: CHLY 101.7 FM
instructions: Send high-quality MP3s (or a single zip) to submissions@chly.ca with the info the form asks for, or post physical copies. No streaming links and no AI-generated music. They also invite a 15-second legal station ID.
notes: Don't use other station addresses for submissions. Questions go to music@chly.ca.

name: CFBX 92.5 FM (The X)
instructions: Mainly accepts physical albums (CD preferred; LPs and cassettes OK) posted to the station. No singles, no generative-AI music. music@thex.ca is for 'music related emails'.
notes: Physical-first and no singles, so a poor match for a band with two digital singles.

name: CKMS 102.7 Radio Waterloo
instructions: Email links to a downloadable digital release (or attach files) and it is made available to hosts; MP3 192 kbps with full metadata and an EPK. Physical CDs/vinyl can be posted. You can also contact genre-matched show hosts directly.
notes: The page explicitly invites emailed digital releases. Only direct submissions are accepted; links to Bandcamp/Spotify etc. are not licensed for play.

name: CHSR 97.9 FM
instructions: Email 320 kbps MP3s as a download link or attachments to the Music Director, or post CDs/LPs/cassettes. They prioritise physical submissions.
notes: The page writes the address as MusicDirector[at]chsrfm[dot]ca. It says 'You can submit your music to us at any time' and covers all genres.

name: CISM 89.3 FM
instructions: Send download links (WeTransfer, Dropbox, Drive; avoid attachments), ideally 320 kbps MP3 with proper metadata, to Romain Roche, head of music programming. A music committee reviews submissions weekly. Please don't send CDs.
notes: Francophone Université de Montréal station, but programming is eclectic and the submission page is open to all.

name: CFCR 90.5 FM
instructions: Send labelled albums/EPs in MP3 (192 kbps preferred) as a file-sharing link (Dropbox, WeTransfer, Bandcamp), not attachments. No individual singles. They recommend !earshot Digital Distribution.
notes: No singles. They only reply to artists they add.

name: CFRU 93.3 FM
instructions: Send download links (320 kbps MP3) for an EP or album of at least 3 different songs to music@cfru.ca, with artist/album info, track listing and contact details. Digital only.
notes: EP/album only (3+ tracks). A separate form is for local Guelph-area musicians.

name: CKUA Radio Network
instructions: Digital only: email streaming plus download links (320 kbps MP3 via Bandcamp, Dropbox, DMDS or PlayMPE) with a one-sheet/bio. No zip files or large attachments, no explicit lyrics. A music committee reviews everything.
notes: Eclectic, listener-supported network; broadcast-quality production required.

name: CJAM 99.1 FM
instructions: Digital only: email the Music Director a download link (Dropbox, WeTransfer or Google Drive), MP3/AAC 192 kbps+ with ID tags, plus an EPK. No Spotify links and no emailed MP3s.
notes: They don't add releases with fewer than four original tracks, so singles won't be added.

name: CFUR 88.7 FM
instructions: Digital (Dropbox, Drive, attached MP3s, Bandcamp code, !earshot) or physical. MP3s must have full metadata; no WAV. One-sheet appreciated. Plays indie rock among other genres.
notes: Prefers albums/EPs over singles 'but we do make exceptions'.

name: CKUW 95.9 FM
instructions: Don't send unsolicited MP3 attachments. Contact the Music Director about digital submissions or send a high-quality download link; physical formats also accepted.
notes: Unsolicited MP3s will not be listened to; download links to the Music Director are fine.

name: Vancouver Co-op Radio CFRO 100.5 FM
instructions: Use the Music Library Submission form (upload or link, track list, CanCon status, CRTC category, suggested shows). Accepts local and non-local artists.
notes: music@coopradio.org is listed for 'Music Submission Inquiries', not for the submissions themselves.

name: Radio Laurier
instructions: Anything from a single to an album: MP3 only, via download link or email attachment, with band name, title, track list, focus tracks, similar artists and a short bio. No streaming-only links.
notes: Favours independent and under-appreciated bands. Online student station at Wilfrid Laurier University.

name: CKRL 89.1 FM
instructions: Send a listening or download link (Dropbox, Google Drive, etc.) to the music department; no audio attachments and no expiring links like WeTransfer.
notes: Francophone community station. The address sits under 'Nous soumettre votre musique'.

name: 3RRR 102.7 FM (Triple R)
instructions: Email music@rrr.org.au with subject 'Music submission: Artist name - release title', a login-free stream link, a 320 kbps MP3/WAV download link (no expiring links), a 1-2 paragraph bio and gig details; no large attachments. You can also service individual presenters directly.
notes: Not playlisted: each presenter picks their own tracks, so pitching specific indie/rock shows helps.

name: PBS 106.7 FM
instructions: Submit digitally via the online form (they welcome local and international acts), or post 4-5 CD/vinyl copies with a one-page bio to the Music Department.
notes: Specialist-music station: soul, jazz, blues, punk, rock, electronic and more. Presenters choose what they play.

name: FBi Radio 94.5 FM
instructions: The contact page lists music@fbiradio.com as the 'Music Submissions' address. No further format guidance was found on the static page.
notes: FBi's music policy strongly favours Australian and Sydney music, so international indie gets less airtime.

name: 4ZZZ 102.1 FM
instructions: Use the online music submission form with a downloadable link (non-downloadable streams are rejected). Music goes to the digital library for all announcers, or you can service announcers directly.
notes: Independent/alternative station. Album of the Week is for Australian releases only.

name: RTRFM 92.1
instructions: Fill in the form or email details to music@rtrfm.com.au with a downloadable WAV/high-quality MP3 link (no attachments). Submit two weeks before release for premiere consideration.
notes: Not playlisted. Weekly 'Sound Selection' of 14 tracks picked by the Music Director.

name: Three D Radio 93.7 FM
instructions: Use the digital music submission form (MP3 only), or post CDs/vinyl to the Music Librarian. They favour full albums/EPs as well as the latest single.
notes: 'Values the best in progressive, alternative and local music.' mail@ is only for problems with the form. Volunteer-run.

name: Radio Adelaide 101.5 FM
instructions: Email your music digitally via WeTransfer, Dropbox or Google Drive (files set to public), with high-quality audio plus artwork and press material.
notes: The page invites independent musicians 'based in Adelaide or anywhere across the country', so the focus is local/Australian.

name: Edge Radio 99.3 FM
instructions: Digital only: email a short bio with gig details, a stream link and a high-quality download link (320 kbps MP3, WAV, FLAC etc.). They aim to listen within 2-4 weeks.
notes: Says it is 'committed to helping new and emerging artists in Tasmania, Australia and around the world'. Only Tasmanian acts should use the 'Tasmanian Music Submission' subject line.

name: 2XX 98.3 FM
instructions: Upload downloadable WAV, FLAC or high-quality MP3 files with a brief artist bio via the submission form.
notes: Plays music 'from all over the world' but with a very strong Australian/Canberran focus.

name: 3CR 855 AM
instructions: The Music Coordinator handles 'music submissions and enquiries'. They accept physical or electronic formats, live sessions and gig recordings.
notes: 55%+ Australian content, with priority for Indigenous, women's, non-English and political music. A weak fit for a UK indie rock band.

name: JOY 94.9
instructions: If you're Australian, independent or LGBTIQA+ and your music suits their daytime or specialist sound, send a stream link to the Music Director.
notes: LGBTIQA+ station with an upbeat pop/RnB daytime sound. Eligible only via the Australian/independent/LGBTIQA+ criteria.

name: SYN Media 90.7
instructions: Service music to music@syn.org.au with a download link (320 kbps MP3 or WAV, no attachments), press release, release date and relevant links. Reviewed on a rolling basis.
notes: Youth-run station (volunteers under 26).

name: triple j Unearthed
instructions: Upload tracks to an Unearthed artist profile; the team moderates each track (up to a week) and may give it airplay on triple j, Double J or Unearthed.
notes: For Australian artists only. triple j's contact page names Unearthed as the route 'if you're an Australian artist', and no route for international acts was found.

name: 95bFM
instructions: Email a streaming link AND a download link to a lossless file, and say if/when you'll be playing nearby.
notes: University of Auckland alternative station; very high submission volume.

name: Radio One 91FM
instructions: The contact page lists music@r1.co.nz under 'Music Submissions' and gives a PO Box for physical submissions.
notes: Otago student station. Music Director: Maddy Barnes.

name: Radio Active 88.6 FM
instructions: The contact page lists 'Music Submissions: music@radioactive.fm or post music'.
notes: Independent alternative/indie station (formerly Victoria University student radio).

name: Wellington Access Radio
instructions: Send your music to the named address to be considered for the playlist; all genres accepted for playlisting and specialty shows.
notes: 'We play New Zealand music as often as we can.' Access/community format.

name: FM4 (ORF)
instructions: For music servicing ('Musik-Bemusterung'), email info with metadata, download links, your website and socials; no file attachments.
notes: Austria's alternative/indie public station; plays plenty of English-language indie. FM4 Soundpark is a separate route for Austrian acts.

name: IndieXL
instructions: Upload a new single on the submit page as a tagged 320 kbps MP3 named 'Band - Title.mp3' (max 12 MB). No YouTube/Spotify/Bandcamp/SoundCloud links. Listen first to check you fit the format.
notes: Dutch indie/alternative station that says it gives new talent a chance. No hip hop, pop, EDM or AI-made music.

name: Pinguin Radio
instructions: The about page sends 'Music plugging and playlists submissions' to Musisum, a separate artist platform (free account) for pitching to partner radio stations.
notes: Dutch indie/alternative station. Musisum offers a free account; it wasn't checked whether paid tiers are needed for pitching. support@pinguinradio.com is for tech support only.

name: Kölncampus
instructions: 'Bemusterungen, Präsentationen und Interviewangebote' (music servicing, presentations and interview offers) go to musik@koelncampus.com.
notes: Cologne university radio with an alternative/indie music format.

name: Radio Q
instructions: The contact page lists musik@radioq.de for 'Musikanfragen oder Bemusterung' (music enquiries or servicing).
notes: Münster campus radio.

name: eldoradio*
instructions: The contact page lists musik@eldoradio.de as the address for the music desk (Musikredaktion). No format guidance given.
notes: TU Dortmund campus radio.

name: hertz 87.9
instructions: The music desk is serviced with new releases daily; its weekly meeting picks the best songs. Contact musik@radiohertz.de.
notes: Bielefeld campus radio.

name: Radio free FM
instructions: The contact page lists musik@freefm.de for the music desk (Musikredaktion). No format guidance given.
notes: Non-commercial free radio in Ulm. The address is a dedicated music-desk inbox, but there's no explicit invitation to submit.

name: Radio 3FACH
instructions: 'Du willst deine Musik im 3FACH Tagesprogramm hören?' Email musik@3fach.ch; email only, no CDs.
notes: Lucerne youth/alternative radio with an indie-leaning daytime playlist.

name: Radio X Basel
instructions: The contact page lists music@radiox.ch for 'Musikanfragen' (music enquiries).
notes: Basel cultural radio with an eclectic, indie-friendly format.

name: toxic.fm
instructions: Music servicing ('Musik (Bemusterungen etc.)') goes to musik@toxic.fm.
notes: St. Gallen youth/student radio.

name: Radio RaBe
instructions: The contact page lists musikredaktion@rabe.ch as the music desk address. No format guidance given.
notes: Bern community radio, eclectic programming.

name: Radio FRO 105.0
instructions: The site footer lists musik@fro.at for 'Musikanfragen' (music enquiries).
notes: Linz free radio. Shows are run by independent volunteer producers.

name: Radio Helsinki 92.6
instructions: The contact page lists musikredaktion@helsinki.at as the music desk address.
notes: Graz free radio.

name: FREIRAD 105.9
instructions: The team/contact page lists musik@freirad.at for the music desk.
notes: Innsbruck free radio. The visible music call ('call for local music') targets Tyrolean acts.

name: Radio Grenouille 88.8
instructions: They can't listen to music proposals by phone; email music proposals to prog@radiogrenouille.com.
notes: Marseille associative radio, eclectic/electronic-leaning.

name: Radio Campus Clermont-Ferrand
instructions: Post albums/EPs to the station, or first make contact via the genre-specific programmer form (use the Pop-Rock one).
notes: Part of the Radio Campus France network. That network's music-contacts page (https://www.radiocampus.fr/contact) lists genre inboxes: rock@ and pop@clermont.radiocampus.org.

name: Radio Onda d'Urto
instructions: The music desk takes tips on artists, new releases, interviews and concerts, and proposals of bands for its festival, at musica@radiondadurto.org.
notes: Political/alternative community radio in Brescia; also runs a large summer festival.

name: Novaradio Città Futura
instructions: The contacts page lists redmus@novaradio.info as the music desk ('redazione musicale').
notes: Florence community station tagged indie on Radio Browser.

name: Radio Študent 89.3
instructions: Send news of new music releases, press releases and event invitations to the music editor (music.editor@ or glasbeni.urednik@radiostudent.si). They can't reply to everything.
notes: One of Europe's oldest independent student stations; strong alternative/indie focus. Addresses written with [at] on the page.

name: Studentradion i Sverige
instructions: To tip them off about your music, email musik@studentradion.se; this reaches the music managers at all member stations.
notes: Umbrella organisation for Swedish student radio stations, so one email covers the network.

name: Radio AF
instructions: The about page lists musik@radioaf.se as the Music Manager's address. No format guidance given.
notes: Lund student radio, one of Sweden's largest.

name: Radio Revolt
instructions: The site lists a music producer address (musikkprodusent@studentmediene.no); no explicit submission guidance.
notes: Trondheim student radio. Role-based music address; no explicit invitation to submit.

name: Campus Rádió FM90
instructions: The site lists music@fm90.hu for 'Zenei információk' (music information).
notes: University of Debrecen campus radio, tagged alternative/rock.

name: Radio ARA
instructions: The contact page says 'Submit your music: music@ara.lu'.
notes: Luxembourg's free radio with English-language programming (ARA City).

name: Tuks FM 107.2
instructions: The contact page lists tuksfmsubmissions@up.ac.za for music submissions.
notes: University of Pretoria station with an alternative/rock format.

name: CIVL 101.7 FM
instructions: The contact form has a 'Submit your music' subject option, and the Music Director is listed as music (at) civl (dot) ca.
notes: University of the Fraser Valley campus/community station.

name: CFBU 103.7 FM
instructions: The Music Director handles tracking and music enquiries at md@cfbu.ca; individual DJ emails are in the show descriptions.
notes: Brock University station.

name: CHMR 93.5 FM
instructions: The contact page lists a Music Director email; no format guidance given.
notes: Memorial University station, 'Newfoundland's Only Alternative'.

name: CJRU 1280 AM (Met Radio)
instructions: The Music Librarian's address is listed with a note to check the FAQ for submission info.
notes: Toronto Metropolitan University campus radio. The FAQ page wasn't reachable when checked.

name: CKLU 96.7 FM
instructions: 'Submit Your Music For Airplay: if you're an artist and would like to submit your music to our station, please contact our Program Director.'
notes: Laurentian University station.

name: Trent Radio 92.7 CFFF
instructions: Only local or 'locally relevant' music (e.g. touring bands playing the area) goes in the archive via the Local Music Submissions form; non-local artists should send music directly to individual programmers.
notes: No music director. music@ is for questions.

name: Radio Campus Amiens 87.7 FM
instructions: Listed on the Radio Campus France network page under "CONTACTS MUSIQUE(S) - Vous souhaitez contacter la programmation musicale d'une radio ?" No format guidance; standard practice is a short email with a download link and bio.
notes: Radio Campus France network station; French-language but plays indie/rock.

instructions: 'Jouw muziek onder de aandacht van NPO 3FM brengen kan door te mailen naar muziek@3FM.nl' (email your music to get it noticed).
notes: Dutch national pop/rock youth station; a big reach but a competitive inbox.

instructions: 'Info over playlisten of muziek doorsturen? muziek@urgent.fm' (for playlisting info or sending music).
notes: Ghent student/city alternative station.

name: Campusradio Jena 103.4
instructions: Send music by email to the music desk with download links, or post a physical single/album on CD.

name: radio 98eins
instructions: 'Möchtest du etwas (Musik) promoten? musik@radio98eins.de' (want to promote music?).
notes: Greifswald university radio.

name: Akademickie Radio Centrum 98.2 FM
instructions: Use the contact form and choose 'Dział Muzyczny' (music department: 'want us to play your music? send a CD, demo etc.').
notes: Lublin academic radio.

name: CKDJ 107.9 FM
instructions: Accepts physical and digital submissions via the Music Submissions form. If the form doesn't work, email an album or single zip file with the form info to ckdjmusicac@gmail.com. Don't use other station addresses.
notes: Algonquin College station branded 'Ottawa's New Music'. Takes singles.

name: Radio Nova 99.3
instructions: 'Vil du sende oss musikk? Alt vi får i innboksen til musikk@radionova.no blir vurdert' (everything sent to the music inbox is considered).
notes: Oslo student radio with a music-first, indie-leaning profile.

name: 48FM 100.1
instructions: Email only: send a direct listening link (YouTube, SoundCloud etc.), a WAV download link and contact info, one artist per email. No CDs, no repeated reminders.
notes: Liège campus/city station. Extra info is only useful if linked to the Liège region (e.g. a local gig).

name: Radio Stadtfilter 96.3
instructions: Music servicing goes to musik@stadtfilter.ch, not to individual music desk members. No audio file attachments.
notes: Winterthur community radio.

name: Radiofabrik 107.5
instructions: The contact section lists musik@radiofabrik.at for the music desk ('Mail-Musikredaktion').
notes: Salzburg free radio.

name: Radio Proton
instructions: The team page lists musikredaktion@radioproton.at as the music desk address.
notes: Small Vorarlberg free radio.

name: Radio LoRa 97.5
instructions: Music coordination (music database, 'LoRa Musik' curation, music formats) is reached at musik@lora.ch.
notes: Zurich alternative/community radio.

name: Radio Dio 89.5
instructions: The contact page lists prog@radiodio.org for programming.
notes: Associative rock-leaning radio; a former Ferarock member.

name: Radio Robotic
instructions: For music submissions, send a download link with WAV audio and a link to your Apple Music profile. No MP3s or low-res files.
notes: Indie/alternative 'new music discovery' internet station.

name: Radio Northern Beaches 88.7/90.3
instructions: 'Music submissions can be sent to music @ rnb.org.au'. Any other correspondence to that address is ignored.
notes: General community station.

name: 2NCR FM 92.9
instructions: The contact section lists music@2ncr.org.au alongside the other station inboxes. No format guidance given.
notes: Southern Cross University community station.

name: KINK
instructions: 'Muziek voor op KINK? plug@kink.nl' (music for KINK goes to the plug address). No format guidance given.
notes: Dutch national alternative/indie rock station.

name: FluxFM
instructions: Make your own music and want it on the radio? Email radar@fluxfm.de with subject 'Musikpromo'; the music desk replies if it fits. They can't answer everything.
notes: Berlin indie/alternative station that says it plays lots of newcomer bands. The weekly Radar feature itself spotlights Berlin acts.

name: CJSF 90.1 FM
instructions: Send all music to the Music Coordinator by post or email to cjsfmusc@sfu.ca. The Music Department page has tracking times.
notes: Simon Fraser University campus/community station.

name: Radio Agora 105.5
instructions: The team list gives music@agora.at for the music staff member ('Glasba / Musik, Ton & Technik').
notes: Bilingual Slovenian/German free radio in Carinthia.

name: GDS.FM
instructions: The contact page lists a dedicated promo address alongside the studio address. No format guidance given.
notes: Zurich internet/DAB station, eclectic with indie rock in the mix.

name: CT das radio
instructions: The contact page lists musik@ctdasradio.de as 'Unsere Musikredaktion' (our music desk).
notes: Ruhr-Universität Bochum campus radio.

name: Kootenay Co-op Radio CJLY 93.5
instructions: Don't email the station or programming manager. Use the !earshot Digital Distribution System to reach programmers, or send links to the relevant genre inbox; physical copies can be posted with a one-pager.
notes: The genre inboxes listed (classical, electronic, experimental, folk, heavy, hip hop, jazz, roots, world) have no indie/rock one, so this is a weak fit.

name: Radio Meuh
instructions: Listen first to judge the fit; then post music to their address or simply send a link (WeTransfer, SoundCloud, Mixcloud etc.). Don't expect a reply.
notes: French eclectic web radio (funk, electro, indie). The contact page doesn't show an email, so links go via its contact form.

name: Radio 1 (Prague)
instructions: No submission guidance. The contacts page lists the person responsible for 'program a hudba' (programme and music).
notes: Prague's long-running alternative station; plays a lot of English-language indie. Only a named staff address is given, with no invitation to send music.
